people.name: Abana
people.line: A river of Damascus, preferred by Naaman over the Jordan.

people.name: Damascus
people.line: Ancient city, capital of Syria, important in biblical history.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: Aren’t Abanah and Pharpar, the rivers of Damascus, better than all the waters of Israel? Couldn’t I wash in them, and be clean?” So he turned and went away in a rage.
translations.bsb: Are not the Abanah and Pharpar, the rivers of Damascus, better than all the waters of Israel? Could I not have washed in them and been cleansed?” So he turned and went away in a rage.
translations.kjv: Are not Abana and Pharpar, rivers of Damascus, better than all the waters of Israel? may I not wash in them, and be clean? So he turned and went away in a rage.
